```plato

    //==
    // # Tessellating a parametric surface
    //
    // The grid-shaped tessellation the face-index routine above was written for.
    // UV is the unit square, U the column direction and V the row direction,
    // matching `library Surfaces` and `library Solids`.

    // The parameter for the col-th of nCols samples across one direction. A closed
    // direction spans [0, 1) in nCols steps, because its last sample is the wrap
    // back to the first; an open direction spans [0, 1] in nCols - 1 steps, so both
    // endpoints are sampled. Precondition: nCols > 1.
    GridParameter(col: Integer, nCols: Integer, closed: Boolean): Number
        => col.ToNumber / (closed ? nCols : nCols - 1).ToNumber;
```
